1) Current state
- You're running inference today against GenAI Cloud's hosted API for customer-facing chat and an internal batch reranking job.
- You also have an older in-house GPU cluster that runs some research workloads.

2) Drivers for migration
- Primary: data residency and isolation for proprietary training signals (PII-like).
- Secondary: predictable latency for real-time chat workloads and lower unit cost at scale.

3) Deployment modes you asked about
- Hosted API: fastest to integrate (no infra), good for initial POC and quick fallbacks.
- Dedicated capacity: reserved GPU pools with predictable throughput and isolation (sounds like a strong fit for your production chat).
- Private (VPC / on-prem): for full network isolation and strict compliance controls  relevant if your SOC2 / audit team requires customer-managed networking or on-prem packaging.

Answers at a high level so your security and finance teams have something to review ahead of the call: \

1) Performance (Dedicated, recommended instance class: 4xA100 equivalent)
- Typical single-request p50/p95/p99 for 2k token chat: ~50ms / ~120ms / ~220ms (with continuous batching and KV caching enabled).
- Throughput: ~12001600 tokens/sec per GPU for mixed request sizes; exact numbers vary with model and quantization profile. We'll bring model-specific bench reports to the deep-dive.

2) Private VPC / On-prem onboarding
- Typical timeline: 610 weeks for VPC private deployment (customer-managed infra in cloud) depending on network approvals; on-prem (air-gapped) packaging typically 812 weeks due to customer security reviews and validation testing.
- Support: we provide deployment playbooks, a technical onboarding team (2 engineers for the engagement), and a runbook for HSM/KMS integration. For air-gapped installs we do controlled transfer of install artifacts and on-site validation where required.

3) Pricing (ballpark)
- Hosted API: standard per-token pricing (good for early POC)  well share your tailored quote in the hubspot deal.
- Dedicated: typical discount vs hosted at scale; example: at your expected steady-state throughput, Dedicated commit reduces per-token cost ~3045% vs hosted. Exact numbers in the TCO spreadsheet (Estimated_TCO_Q2_2026.xlsx attached).
